<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 193.1103, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈192.103 Da. The formula that matches this mass within typical high‑resolution tolerance and follows the required format (C x H y O z X) is C₁₀H₁₂O₂N₂.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H12O2N2</final_answer>
